issue.title: `/fix --ci-cd` does not call real /solve command with working session, that leads to no defaults for the solve command applied
issue.author: konard

related_github.why: Original request that /fix work as a combination of /task and /solve, passing through all options not consumed by /fix itself.
The concrete /fix --ci-cd run cited by the issue. Its solve session metadata.json (rawCommand) is the primary evidence.
The working pull request implementing this fix.
Prior work on the mergeArgsWithOverrides helper and info-block de-duplication for /solve and /hive.

external_references.title: yargs advanced documentation
external_references.why: Confirms yargs' last-wins option parsing, which is why overrides are appended at the end of the argument list so they take precedence over user-supplied values.

external_references.title: yargs documentation index
external_references.why: General reference for how solve.mjs / fix.mjs parse options.

primary_evidence.conclusion: The real solve.mjs was spawned (not a fake), but WITHOUT the operator override --attach-logs, proving the root cause is override omission in the /fix path, not a fake solve execution.
